newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA LEU STEADY, MONEY MARKET RATES UP.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA LEU STEADY, MONEY MARKET RATES UP.

text.p: Romania's leu currency closed Wednesday flat at 6,800/850 to the dollar on a dull interbank market where hard currency holders awaited fresh lows.
"Dollar sellers are few as exports have yet to see a recovery after last year's 3.2 percent drop," said a trader.

"The only chance for the market to smooth out is increased foreign investor interest in Romania," said another trader, adding that a bill on foreign ownership of land, now under a parliament scrutiny, might boost foreign capital inflows.
Retail rates were lower than interbank prices and hovered at 6,800/7,290 to the dollar.

Money market rates drifted higher with one-week funds at 94 percent against 90 percent as the market was hit by leu shortages after recent central bank moves to mop up extra liquidity from the market.
